title:
This epic monitors the `Reliability.ChangeSensorSettingsModalOperationalStatusForm` for initial render and changes to form input.
When the form's operationalStatus field is not set to {@link SensorOperationalStatusEnum#FAULTY} the duration field should be disabled.
By default the duration field should be set to "No Expiration" and can only be changed when the operationalStatus field is set to {@link SensorOperationalStatusEnum#FAULTY}

If the user does not have access to Reliability.LimitedModelUser.Role, the whole Operational Status form is disabled and no changes can be made.

Actions Monitored in `Reliability.ChangeSensorSettingsModalOperationalStatusForm`:
- `INITIAL_RENDER`
- `INPUT_CHANGE`
This epic will get input from the state of:
- `Reliability.ChangeSensorSettingsModalOperationalStatusForm`
This epic also retrieves the default duration value from:
- `SensorOperationalDurationOptions`
name: UiSdlEpicDisableOperationalStatusForm
